blockers.title: Post-correction cadence restart re-fires for EVERY post-correction batch — co_nudge and reminders all mislabel as invitation_sent
blockers.detail: After the first post-correction batch restarts (cycle_index=0), the accumulator becomes (1, …); every later batch still satisfies Gt && batch_index > 0, so cycle_index resets to 0 again. A corrected row's full re-cadence (correct_reference_call.sql:32 resets attempt_count=0 → invite + co_nudge + 2 reminders) renders co_nudge/reminders as invitation_sent with empty detail — ordinals never emitted. The only restart test feeds ONE post-correction batch, so CI stays green while AC1 fails for every corrected row.
blockers.recommended_fix: Carry a restarted flag (or the post-restart position) in the fold accumulator so only the FIRST batch strictly after corrected_at resets to 0; subsequent batches continue co_nudge/reminder_sent. Extend attempt_log_restarts_cadence_after_correction_test with ≥2 post-correction batches pinning co_nudge and reminder ordinals.

blockers.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
blockers.evidence: P0 100% (timeline render + order preservation, export content, dropdown totality, 5-type codec round-trips, back-compat decode, builder happy paths, payload wiring, no-duplicate-terminals pin, preference matrix, §7.9 verbatim pins). P1 <80%: the cadence-restart defect above shipped through a one-batch restart test; the OQ-5 export toast (AC2 headline) has no pin at the firing arms or its verbatim copy; 3 of 5 terminal writers' terminalized_at stamps have no integration assertion.
blockers.detail: Gate FAIL per the tests-lens thresholds (P1 < 80%): the P0 layer is fully covered, but the P1 holes let a real defect (the restart re-fire) reach review, and the story's spec-verbatim toast copy is unpinned anywhere.
blockers.recommended_fix: Fix the restart and add the multi-batch post-correction test; pin AppCompletedRefcheckExport Ok/Error toasts to verbatim copy; add terminalized_at assertions for terminalize (refused/objected), exhaust, and sweep_mark_failed.

warnings.title: collapse_same_at_sends drops ANY consecutive same-at line regardless of kind — reachable: legacy taken-over rows lose their terminal line
warnings.detail: The guard compares only `at`, not kind. Concrete reachable case: a pre-RC4.4 unreachable row taken over post-migration — take_over_reference_call.sql stamps taken_over_at and updated_at with one now(), and the builder's terminal fallback lands on updated_at, so terminal and taken_over share one at and the terminal line vanishes from both timeline and export. send_line also folds same-at lifecycle entries into send batches (empty channel mislabels).
warnings.recommended_fix: Restrict the collapse to send kinds (both prev and line in invitation_sent/co_nudge/reminder_sent, or key on (at, kind)); add a boundary test: send batch + lifecycle entry sharing one `at` must render both lines.

warnings.title: Legacy-row terminal fallback uses updated_at — the column the migration's own comment documents as polluted by takeovers
warnings.detail: For legacy unreachable rows (terminalized pre-migration, no terminalized_at/submitted_at/objected_at), a later takeover bumps updated_at, so the terminal event is stamped AT the takeover instant — wrong evidence timestamp (and the root of the collapse collision above).
warnings.recommended_fix: When taken_over_at is set, skip the updated_at fallback (prefer objected_at/submitted_at, or emit no terminal entry); never timestamp the terminal event from a post-terminal write.

warnings.title: failed (and v2 completed) rows get contradictory evidence labels: timeline "Closed" + export outcome "In progress"
warnings.detail: failed is a live v1 terminal (sweep error paths stamp terminalized_at; the panel renders the state and the export button). Its exported Outcome reads "In progress" while the timeline reads "Closed" — contradictory claims in an evidence-grade record.
warnings.recommended_fix: Add explicit "failed" (and "completed") arms to both tables with honest labels, plus a table test pinning every status.

warnings.title: Queued taken-over rows lose the export affordance — §7.7's export-beside-the-chips contract breaks
warnings.detail: Take-over is offered on queued rows (hooks.can_take_over includes Queued; take_over_reference_call.sql allows it) and the taken-over surface renders chips + label — but the export affordance now lives only in the attempt-log block, which Queued suppresses. RC4.3 shipped the export on the takeover surface; RC4.4 removes it for this reachable state.
warnings.recommended_fix: Render the export affordance for taken-over rows regardless of status (e.g. let the log/export block render when taken_over_at is set), preserving the RC4.3 takeover-surface export.

warnings.title: Em-dash enforcement gap: "Closed — no reply" is unexempted new copy and the nine new dash-free consts skip the scan list
warnings.detail: The no_em_dash_test pin only reaches toast/page arms + refcheck_action_strings. "Closed — no reply" is a fn-built string carrying an em-dash without the by-construction exclusion the OQ-5 toast got, and the nine new dash-free consts are in no scanned list — the ban silently stops covering the new surface.
warnings.recommended_fix: Add the nine consts to refcheck_action_strings; either de-dash "Closed — no reply" or document its spec-verbatim exclusion beside the fn (mirroring the OQ-5 pattern).

warnings.title: Skipped co-nudge renders a dangling " — " and loses its skip reason (builder ships empty detail for co_nudge)
warnings.detail: The wire's co_nudge entry now ships detail "" (the builder emits detail only for reminders), but nudge_label unconditionally joins " — " + detail — a skipped co-nudge renders "Applicant nudge skipped — " with a trailing dash and the RC4.3 skip reason is dropped from the record.
warnings.recommended_fix: Carry the attempt's detail for co_nudge entries in build_send_entries, and/or guard the " — " join on non-empty detail in nudge_label.

warnings.title: OQ-5 verbatim export toast has no pin — success/failure arms and copy unpinned, const out of the em-dash scan
warnings.evidence:
True, Ok(_) -> add_toast(Model(..model, clipboard_copied: None), copy.refcheck_toast_exported, ToastSuccess)
// no test dispatches AppCompletedRefcheckExport; only the clipboard state marker is pinned
warnings.detail: The toast fires with the verbatim OQ-5 const (verified), but no test pins the firing arms or the exact copy — a copy regression or a dropped toast ships silently, and the const left the em-dash scan.
warnings.recommended_fix: Add a test dispatching AppCompletedRefcheckExport(_, Ok(_)) on a current route asserting the toast equals copy.refcheck_toast_exported verbatim, plus the Error arm → refcheck_toast_export_failed.

notes.title: New client + pre-RC4.4 server payload renders an empty timeline/export for in-flight rows during the rollout window
notes.detail: The decoder defaults attempt_log to [] (documented, negative-control-pinned), so a new bundle hitting an old revision mid-rollout shows no timeline and an empty export Timeline section for started rows. Bounded, transient, no data loss — documented behavior, not a defect.
notes.recommended_fix: None required; optional: fall back to the attempts-derived summary when attempt_log is empty.

notes.title: Cadence hint counts send batches across correction cycles, hiding "what happens next" during cycle-2
notes.detail: A corrected row runs a second 4-batch cadence; the count vs 4 compares across cycles, so the hint is suppressed mid-cycle-2. Pre-existing heuristic (RC4.2 mini-timeline), cosmetic, not event-state re-derivation.
notes.recommended_fix: Count send batches only since the latest corrected entry, or ship a next-step flag from the server.
